name: @etzhayyim/fleamarket-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of the fleamarket PUBLIC catalog (C2C listings + bids) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS. Mixed split: transaction settlement (escrow/MoR) + shipping (fulfillment liability + address PII) stays etzhayyim (consent-capability); only the public listing/bid catalog is etzhayyim-front. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-2606011400.
